name: @agent-desktop/desktop
description: Juno — open-source Mac client for a self-hosted agent server.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-mac-helper.mjs && node scripts/build-chrome-bridge.mjs && electron-vite dev --watch
scripts.build: node scripts/build-mac-helper.mjs && node scripts/build-chrome-bridge.mjs && electron-vite build
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-cua-driver.mjs && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
